market_header.rules:
MARKET INFORMATION

For further information please see Rules & Regs.

Who will win this race? Betfair Non-Runner Rule applies. Reduction factors may be updated periodically at the discretion of Betfair based on trading in the market, but after approximately 5 minutes from scheduled ‘off’ time of a given race, they will be updated only in exceptional circumstances. Odds of matched bets will only be adjusted if there are ADDITIONAL non-runners after your bet is matched. This market will turn IN PLAY at the off with all unmatched bets cancelled once the Betfair SP reconciliation process has been completed. Betting will be suspended at the end of the race. This market will initially be settled on a First Past the Post basis. However we will re-settle all bets should the official result at the time of the "weigh-in" announcement differ from any initial settlement. Dead Heat rules apply.

BSP (Betfair Starting Price) operates on this market. For more information about setting a Starting Price odds limit click here

This is a cross-matching market.

Customers should be aware that:
  1. Transmissions described as "live" by some broadcasters may actually be delayed and that all in-play races are not necessarily televised;
  2. The extent of any such delay may vary between customers, depending on the set-up through which they are receiving pictures or data.
  3. Information (such as jockey silks, saddlecloth numbers etc) is provided "as is" and is for guidance only. Betfair does not guarantee the accuracy of this information and use of it to place bets is entirely at your own risk.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Makes her debut for the Sally Wynne stable, with Sally Wynne also taking the ride from barrier 3. By Harry Angel out of Dress, she is a half-sister to Revenue Raiser, who is still winless from three starts. Not the worst.
rnsMetadata.owner: N Noblett, Tucker Up  (Mgr: T Brown), Natural Kraft (Mgr: A Harris), W Mciver, G Tamvakologos, J Buchanan & Mrs A Buchanan
rnsMetadata.jockeyColours: White, Black Stripes, Black Horseshoe, Black Cap

runnerMetadata.coloursDescription: Navy Blue White Sash Lime Green Striped Sleeves Quartered Cap

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Starts her career for Andrew Noblet with Thomas Stockdale booked, and that combination gives this Rubick filly a solid platform on debut. There is no race form to measure her against, but she comes from a Group 1-winning stable and draws the middle of the line in barrier 7. Showing good signs at the jumpouts and can make an impression on debut.
rnsMetadata.jockeyColours: Navy Blue, White Sash, Lime Green Striped Sleeves, Quartered Cap

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Returns from a five-week let-up after finishing sixth on debut at Ballarat, beaten three and a half lengths behind Miss Dividend. She was near the top of betting there and was steadied approaching the 100m, so the run had enough merit to build on second-up. Can fire a shot second-up.
rnsMetadata.owner: J G Falcke, H McDonald, T A Hartley, Northerly Holdings Pty Ltd (Mgr: R Portaro) & Mrs J R McGrath

formHistory.positionComments: sixth on settling, sixth at 800m, sixth on turn

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Debuts from barrier 5 with Liana Wood claiming 3kg, which gives this Tassort filly a practical weight advantage first time to the races. Smiley Chan has had four debut runners for one win and two placings, so the stable can prepare one to run well fresh. Has some positives, but stronger profiles sit above her.
rnsMetadata.owner: C F Tang, WINTV Syndicate (Mgr: F Lo) & Miss S W Tam
rnsMetadata.jockeyColours: Royal Blue, Yellow Chevron Band, Yellow Sleeves, Red Stripes

runnerMetadata.coloursDescription: Lime Green Blue Checked Sleeves & Cap

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Begins from barrier 1 for Grahame Begg, and that draw gives this Too Darn Hot filly every chance to handle her first race-day assignment. Jordan Childs is booked, and the stable's debut record of seven wins from 39 starts is respectable. The inside draw is a big tick and her jumpouts have been solid coming in.
rnsMetadata.owner: M J Ryan, D J Stent, Seven Media Middle East (Mgr: M Slater), Mrs D L Benton & R G Havens
rnsMetadata.jockeyColours: Lime Green, Blue Checked Sleeves And Cap

runnerMetadata.coloursDescription: Green Gold Diamond Armbands White Cap

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Has race fitness on her side and was fourth at Cranbourne last start, beaten six lengths after racing wide in the early stages. The start prior at Donald was plain, finishing last over 1200m after covering ground throughout, and she was big odds both times. Not to be discounted.
rnsMetadata.owner: S P Nichols, Ms B E Nichols, Mrs K M Gardiner, Mrs L M Stead, Mrs J L Richardson, Mrs K M Harding, Miss R Harding, Ms S Townsend, Mrs T Wacura, Mrs G Brayne, Miss H Greig, Ms S Wilkinson, The M.O.S.T (Mgr: Mrs L Taylor) & Miss R J Thomas
rnsMetadata.jockeyColours: Green, Gold Diamond, Armbands, White Cap

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Returns from a lengthy ten-month spell with the best exposed form in the race, having debuted in the G3 Blue Diamond Preview (Fillies) and finished seventh, beaten just over five lengths behind Rubi's Choice. She began slowly and was easily accounted for there, but this is a clear drop from F Open company into a F Mdn. Looks ready to fire on resumption.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Returns from a lengthy ten-month spell after finishing sixth on debut in an Open at Flemington, beaten eight and a half lengths behind Big Sky. She jumped awkwardly that day and did not quicken after travelling prominently, so there is improvement to find. Looks ready for a strong showing on resumption.

rnsMetadata.runnerForm: Debuts for Anthony & Sam Freedman with Damian Lane taking the ride, which is a strong starting point for a filly yet to be exposed under race pressure. By The Autumn Sun out of Vona, she was a $95,000 yearling purchase and has a half-sibling in Mount Bona with four wins. May need some luck in running, but there's enough substance to suggest she can run well.
